_meta.description: Every adjustable assumption in the Subsidy Math model. Single source for the microsite engine (src/lib/subsidy-math/model.ts) and the Excel workbook (scripts/subsidy-math/build_model.py). basis: D = disclosed in a filing, R = reported estimate, A = our assumption, C = our calculation on disclosed figures.

customerDiscount.note: Negotiated recurring discount off list (private pricing / commit discount).

discountFundedByProvider.note: Share of the negotiated discount Anthropic funds (it sets price as principal).

channelFee.note: Distribution fee AWS keeps. Bounded by Anthropic's S-1/A channel-partner fees vs CSP-marketplace revenue.

providerServingCost.note: Anthropic functional cost of revenue / revenue, 9M 2026 ($4,812M / $33,242M).

hostedShare.note: Share of Bedrock-Claude serving compute that runs on AWS capacity.

incrementalComputeShare.note: Share of that compute that is incremental to Anthropic's take-or-pay AWS commitment.

computeMargin.note: AWS margin on AI compute sold to Anthropic.

infraCost.note: n/a for agent route (provider bears serving cost).

customerDiscount.note: MACC / commit discount applied to Azure OpenAI.

discountFundedByProvider.note: n/a — Microsoft is principal; OpenAI bears its revenue-share percentage of any discount.

revenueShare.note: Reported revenue share Microsoft pays OpenAI on Azure OpenAI revenue.

infraCost.note: Serving infrastructure (GPU depreciation, power, network/DC) per $ of list.

modelDevCost.note: OpenAI funds training; Microsoft's share of OpenAI losses is shown separately as strategic.

infraCost.note: TPU serving cost per $ of list.

modelDevCost.note: Gemini training and research amortized per $ of revenue (economic view).

channelFee.note: Same S-1/A bound as AWS; not split by CSP.

providerServingCost.note: Anthropic functional cost of revenue / revenue, 9M 2026.

hostedShare.note: Share served on Google TPU capacity.

incrementalComputeShare.note: Incremental to Anthropic's Google Cloud take-or-pay commitment.

computeMargin.note: Google margin on TPU compute sold to Anthropic.

pct.note: Field observation (unverified): ~35% AWS incentive on Anthropic workloads.

partnerFunded.note: Share of the incentive funded by an SI/reseller partner.

providerFunded.note: Share funded by the model provider.

growth.note: Annual growth in list-price AI spend.

retention.note: Probability the workload stays each year.

priceDeflation.note: Annual list-price decline per unit of capability.

efficiencyGain.note: Annual decline in serving cost per unit.

adjacencyAttach.note: Non-AI cloud revenue per $1 of AI spend.

adjacencyIncremental.note: Share of adjacent revenue that is genuinely incremental.

adjacencyMargin.note: Gross margin on adjacent cloud services.

commitAdjacencyUplift.note: Committed adjacent revenue per $1 of AI spend bought by a commit-conditional credit.

baselineShare.note: Pre-existing spend excluded from consumption credits (0 = net-new).

stake.note: Hyperscaler economic stake in the model provider.

revenueMultiple.note: Provider equity value per $1 of annual revenue.

incrementalToProvider.note: Share of subsidized consumption that is new revenue for the provider (vs shifted from its direct channel or another cloud).
